verdict.rationale: Apple documents several official SDKs and frameworks for building against M5. Metal 4 Tensor APIs let developers program the Neural Accelerators directly, alongside Core ML, Metal Performance Shaders, the Foundation Models framework, the open-source MLX framework with Neural Accelerator support, and PyTorch Metal backends. Community remarks that Apple's libraries are 'insular' are skepticism, not contradiction. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with these SDKs on M5, in-depth M5-specific API documentation beyond newsroom-level claims, and AI-native doc affordances (llms.txt returns 404).
